Container.Name: tidb-plex
Container.Overview: Fills in Plex's intro and credits markers from TheIntroDB, so Plex does not have to fingerprint every file. Terminal and command line only: run it once with `docker exec -it tidb-plex /tidb-plex` to open the interface, and let the scheduler run `sync` for you.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server, as reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Your Plex token. Find it in Plex Web: open any item, then Get Info, View XML, and copy the X-Plex-Token value from the URL.

Config.Name: TheIntroDB API key
Config.Description: Optional. An API key raises the allowance to 1000 requests a day and includes your own pending submissions.

Config.Name: Plex Media Server folder
Config.Description: The Plex application support folder, mounted READ ONLY. Must be the real path, not an Unraid /mnt/user FUSE path: SQLite locking there is unreliable and a write can corrupt the database. For the official Plex container that is /mnt/cache/appdata/plex/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server, or use the Docker volume path if Plex stores its library on a volume.

Config.Name: Plex database path
Config.Description: Leave empty to use the database inside the mounted folder. The database is at Plug-in Support/Databases/com.plexapp.plugins.library.db inside the application support folder, which the tool finds by itself; set this only if you mounted something unusual.

Config.Name: State folder
Config.Description: Ledger, backups of the Plex database, undo journals and fingerprints. Back this up: without the ledger the tool cannot tell its own markers from Plex's.

Config.Name: Enable chapters source
Config.Description: Use chapter names Plex already extracted. Free: no lookups and no media reads, exact for the file on disk.

Config.Name: Enable local detection
Config.Description: Fingerprint episodes that TheIntroDB does not have yet. Needs ffmpeg and fpcalc, which this image does not include, so leave it off unless you build your own image.

Config.Name: Allow writing while Plex runs
Config.Description: Off by default. When on, a run still refuses to write if anything is playing.

Config.Name: Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression for the daily sync. It runs after Plex's own maintenance window so the two are not fighting over the database.

Config.Name: Run once on start
Config.Description: Run a sync as soon as the container starts, before waiting for the first scheduled run. Off by default, so recreating the container does not by itself write to your library.
